en.title: Earliest Integer Second When Cumulative Usage Reaches the Threshold
en.description:
Each user contributes 1 usage at every integer second from start to end. Find the integer second at which the cumulative usage first reaches max_usage. CSWork standard I/O convention: output −1 if the threshold is never reached.

This site independently wrote the standard I/O and judging; ranges marked as this site's are not original source constraints.
en.input: The first line contains n max_usage (1≤n≤100000, 1≤max_usage≤10¹⁴), followed by n lines of start end (1≤start≤end≤10⁹).
en.explanation: Example 1: the cumulative total is 1 at second 1; at second 2 both users contribute 1 each, for a cumulative 3, so output 2. Example 2: starting and ending in the same second still contributes 1, and the threshold is first reached at second 5. Example 3: the total usage is only 1 and never reaches 2, so output −1 per this site's convention.
hints: Record a +1 event at start and a −1 event at end+1, and sort by time. Between adjacent events the active count is fixed, so accumulate segment by segment; when the threshold falls inside a segment, use ceiling division to find the minimum number of seconds.
